raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: coal
  cppname: libcoal
  pythonname: coal-python
  version: 3.0.4

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/coal-library/${{ name }}/releases/download/v${{ version }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0a9091aa281f51b9513f11aae39758a6188bca63010524f36b3bdc566381ca4a

build:
  number: 1

outputs:
  - package:
      name: ${{ cppname }}
    build:
      script:
        - if: win
          then: build_cppcoal.bat
          else: build_cppcoal.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        # XML generation seem to be broken in some doxygen version
        - doxygen <1.9.8|>=1.11,<1.13
      host:
        - eigen
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - assimp
        - octomap
        - libboost-devel
        - qhull
        - if: not win
          then: qhull-static
      run:
        - eigen
        - libboost-devel
        # Since qhullcpp is leaking in header file
        # consumer will need it to build against coal
        - if: not win
          then: qhull-static
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(cppname, upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - coal/fwd.hh
            - coal/config.hh
          lib:
            - coal
      - script:
          - cmake-package-check coal --target coal::coal
        requirements:
          run:
            - cmake-package-check
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      - script: 
          - pkg-config --modversion ${{ name }}
        requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
  - package:
      name: ${{ pythonname }}
    build:
      script:
        - if: win
          then: build_coal_python.bat
          else: build_coal_python.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        # XML generation seem to be broken in some doxygen version
        - doxygen <1.9.8|>=1.11,<1.13
        - if: not win
          then:
            - pylatexenc
            - lxml
      host:
        - eigen
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - assimp
        - octomap
        - libboost-devel
        - qhull
        - if: not win
          then: qhull-static
        - python
        - libboost-python-devel
        - eigenpy
        # On Windows, Numpy 2.0 don't allow to export the PY_ARRAY_UNIQUE_SYMBOL.
        # This has been fixed in Numpy 2.1.
        - if: win
          then: numpy >=2.1
          else: numpy
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(cppname, exact=true) }}
      run:
        - python
        - if: not win
          then: numpy
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(cppname, exact=true) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - coal
  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}
    requirements:
      host:
        # Explicitely add a python requirement so that the hash changes between python version
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(cppname, exact=true) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(pythonname, exact=true) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(cppname, exact=true) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - coal
      - script:
          - cmake-package-check coal --target coal::coal
        requirements:
          run:
            - cmake-package-check
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      - script: 
          - pkg-config --modversion ${{ name }}
        requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
